description: Log redaction (NFR-14): quoted text and file paths become short hashes (the first 8 hex digits of SHA-256 of the UTF-8 text). Python's debrief_tools.diagnostics and the extension's diagnostics are both held to these cases.

cases.line: The plot has no feature 'track-nelson'; refresh and select again.
